messages:
rachel: Heads-up: prod-aps1 GPU warm pool is failing node join after the midnight rollout. Nodes show KMS Decrypt denied and NACL DROP on attestation egress. Warmup stalled ~15 nodes.

infra-bot: ALERT 1791112222 - warm-pool-join x15 failed in prod-aps1. Errors: KMS_GRANT_EXPIRED, ENI_ATTACH_TIMEOUT, NACL_DROP to 10.50.8.10:443 (attestation).

samir: Looking at the change history: we rotated the HSM key and deployed a tighter NACL rule (deny all outbound except management). The attestation path to audit-shipper uses a private IP that isn't in the new allowlist. Two independent failures converged.

jun: Quick options: (1) issue a scoped 60m KMS grant for allocator role + add ephemeral NACL allow for audit-shipper IPs from prod-aps1 NAT; (2) revert the NACL change for the affected subnets; (3) drain warm pool and fallback to prod-usw2 warmers (expensive). I prefer (1) to minimize blast radius.

sec-bot: Security conditions for (1): grant must be scoped to arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-allocator, TTL=60m enforced, creation logged to s3://secure-audit/aps1/, two-person approval required, revoke automated. Approve with those constraints.

rachel: I'll run (1) now. Steps: create-grant with EncryptionContextSubset {"purpose":"hsm-attest"}, terraform apply -target=aws_network_acl_rule.attest-allow -var='env=prod-aps1' (60m TTL), schedule revoke lambda. Sanitized command:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/infra-hsm --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-allocator --operations Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"purpose":"hsm-attest"}}' --name ephemeral-aps-attest > /tmp/grant.json
terraform apply -target=aws_network_acl_rule.attest-allow -var='env=prod-aps1'
```

infra-bot: UPDATE: grant created grantId=gr-aps1-ephemeral; network acl patched; nodes requeued. Progress: joined 9/15, 6 retrying.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-20260329-APS1 created, priority=P1, owner=rachel, sec-approver=samir. Estimated fallout: cross-region fallback cost ~2.1TB/day => ~$310/day egress if used.

samir: Logged grant metadata to s3://secure-audit/aps1/2026-03-29/grants/gr-aps1-ephemeral.json and recorded approvals. Scheduled revoke in 60m.

jun: Follow-ups: (A) hook allocator sessions to key-rotation webhook so sessions refresh on rotate; (B) add NACL regression test to CI to include audit-shipper IPs; (C) decide whether audit-shipper should be behind a stable service endpoint rather than hard-coded IPs. I'll open PRs.

infra-bot: FINAL: warm pool stabilized; final status 15/15 joined. Monitor window 2h. Revoke scheduled at 2026-03-29T02:08:00Z.
